questions.stem: A student obtains these titration results: 24.60, 23.85, 23.90, 23.80 cm³. What is the correct mean titre?
questions.explanation: The first result (24.60 cm³) is anomalous and should be discarded. Only concordant results (within 0.1 cm³ of each other) are used. The mean of 23.85, 23.90, and 23.80 is (23.85 + 23.90 + 23.80) / 3 = 23.85 cm³.
